data: Which of the following methods achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon Score in SST dataset?

The question asks which method achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon Score in the SST dataset. From the caption, we know that the distance is generally smaller with post-hoc methods for all models. The figure shows three subfigures, but we need to focus on the one labeled (b) SST. In this subfigure, we can see multiple lines representing different methods. The line representing the SHAP x background method appears to be the lowest among all the lines, indicating that it achieves the lowest Jensen-Shannon Score in the SST dataset. Therefore, the answer is the SHAP x background method.
